title: Closed-Loop Cognitive Cycle Contract
description: Request and response payload contracts for `sekha-cluster-tool orchestrate`, which coordinates all four stages in a single closed-loop turn and collects per-stage telemetry. The response object is emitted verbatim to stdout by the CLI. Stage sub-objects reuse the contracts in filter.json, recall.json, deliberate.json, and consolidate.json. Property names mirror the compiled tool's JSON tags exactly and must never be anglicised.

StageTelemetry.description: Execution duration and status for one stage of the cognitive loop.

stage_name.description: Stage label (e.g. sensory, recall, deliberation, consolidation).

node.description: Cognitive layer that served the stage.

endpoint.description: Resolved endpoint the stage was dispatched to.

duration_ms.description: Stage duration in milliseconds; compare against the documented sub-second hop budget.

status.description: Stage status (e.g. ok, degraded, error, skipped).

error.description: Error detail when the stage failed or degraded.

request.description: Configuration for a full cognitive turn. Populated from the CLI flags --input, --directive, --trace-id, and --sync.

raw_input.description: The raw sensory stream to process (CLI flag --input).

task_directive.description: Attention and reasoning directive for the turn (CLI flag --directive).

session_id.description: Session identifier threaded through the turn.

synchronous_consolidate.description: When true (CLI flag --sync), block on Stage 4 consolidation statistics.

response.description: End-to-end outcome of the four-stage cognitive cycle with nested stage payloads and telemetry.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier for the whole turn.

status.description: Overall turn status (e.g. ok, degraded, error).

proposed_action.description: The action proposed at the end of the turn.

is_complete.description: True when the loop reached a terminal conclusion.

stages.description: Ordered per-stage telemetry for latency and status inspection.
